header.title: Mermaid Generator
header.navigationHint: Open workspace actions without leaving the mobile layout.

editor.title: Mermaid source
editor.help: Paste Mermaid directly or keep refining the current draft. This source stays canonical, so preview and export always derive from it.

prompt.title: Prompt draft
prompt.help: Turn a short brief into Mermaid with your selected provider. The selected provider returns Mermaid that replaces the current editor content.
prompt.placeholder: Describe a system, process, or architecture to generate Mermaid from text.
prompt.locked: Add a {provider} API key in Settings to unlock prompt-based generation on this device.
prompt.wideDiagram: This generated diagram is very wide. Ask for grouped stages or shorter labels if you want a more balanced export.
prompt.tallDiagram: This generated diagram is very tall. Ask for fewer stacked levels or broader grouping if you want a more balanced export.
prompt.generatedRenderMessage: This generated draft could not be rendered. Refine the prompt or edit the source directly, then try again.
prompt.manualRenderMessage: This Mermaid source could not be rendered. Review the editor content and correct the syntax to restore the preview.
prompt.generationFailed: Unable to generate Mermaid from this prompt.
prompt.validationFailed: The generated Mermaid could not be validated. Your current diagram was kept unchanged. Refine the prompt and try again.
prompt.providerBrowserBlocked: {provider} browser requests are blocked by CORS. {detail}

preview.title: Preview
preview.help: Use preview as the review surface. Hold Shift while scrolling to zoom, drag to pan, and export the full diagram rather than the current viewport framing.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Choose the active provider, keep keys local to this browser, and review app release notes.
settings.browserWarning: Direct browser calls for this provider are blocked from arbitrary origins. Generation requires a local proxy that adds the required CORS permissions.
settings.keyStorageHelp: Keys stay on this device in local browser storage. You can keep multiple provider keys and switch the active provider without losing the others.

export.title: Export diagram
export.subtitle: Choose the output format and raster scale before downloading.
export.svgDescription: Vector export for docs and further editing.
export.pngDescription: Raster export with selectable output scale.
export.shareHelp: Copy a share link when you want this Mermaid source to reopen with the editor prefilled and the preview already in sync.
export.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable for share links.
export.shareCopyFailed: Unable to copy the share link right now.
export.pngLoadFailed: PNG export failed to load SVG.
export.canvasFailed: PNG export failed to create a canvas context.
export.blobFailed: PNG export failed to create an image blob.

changelog.title: Changelog history
changelog.subtitle: Review shipped releases without leaving the workspace.
changelog.loadFailed: Unable to load changelog history right now.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Mermaid Generator keeps the whole diagram loop in one browser workspace: write or describe, review the result, then export a clean asset.
welcome.detail: The preview stays primary so you can judge structure quickly without losing the underlying Mermaid source.

editor.title: Code editor
editor.body: The Mermaid source remains the artifact you control. Paste existing Mermaid or refine generated output directly in the editor.
editor.detail: Every preview and export comes from this source, so manual edits stay first-class.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.body: Use the prompt panel when you want a first draft from text. Pick a provider in Settings, save its key locally, then generate Mermaid without leaving the app.
prompt.detail: The generated output is still editable, so AI stays a starting point rather than a black box.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: Review the diagram in the large preview stage. Fit the diagram, zoom, pan, or switch into preview focus when you want a cleaner review surface.
preview.detail: Hold Shift while scrolling to zoom and drag the stage to move around larger diagrams.

export.title: Export
export.body: When the diagram is ready, open Export to choose SVG or PNG and, for PNG, the raster scale before downloading.
export.detail: Exports always use the full rendered diagram rather than the current zoom position.
